test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank meaningfully.

The citizens of Iraq wanted ____________ after years of war.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**' i.e. **peace**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Peace"** means a state of tranquility or freedom from war and conflict. (शांति)
 
• This word is appropriate in the context of the sentence, which refers to the desire of Iraqi citizens after prolonged war.
 
• **Example:** After decades of civil unrest, the people longed for lasting **peace**.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The citizens of Iraq wanted **peace**__ after years of war.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Peice** (गलत वर्तनी): Misspelling of "piece". Not valid.
 
• **Pease** (पुराना शब्द): An archaic plural of "pea". Not used in modern English.
 
• **Piece** (टुकड़ा): Refers to a part or portion of something.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave me a piece of cake. (Used in a different context)
